title: Plans & pricing: Bolt’s AI powered website and app builder

facts.fact: Bolt's Free plan costs $0 per month and is free forever with no credit card required.
Bolt's Pro plan costs $25 per month when billed monthly.
Bolt's Teams plan costs $30 per member per month when billed monthly.
Bolt's Enterprise plan is priced custom to each customer and includes advanced security, compliance, and 24/7 support.
facts.quote: Get advanced security, compliance, and 24/7 support. Customized to your team's exact needs.

facts.fact: Bolt states that yearly billing saves up to 28% compared with monthly billing.
facts.quote: Save up to 28% with yearly billing

facts.fact: The Free plan includes a daily token limit of 300K tokens.
The Free plan includes 1M tokens per month.
The Free plan includes up to 333k web requests.
The Free plan has a 10MB file upload limit.
The Free plan displays Bolt branding on websites.
The Pro plan starts at 10M tokens per month and has no daily token limit.
The Pro plan has a 100MB file upload limit.
The Pro plan includes up to 1M web requests.
The Pro plan removes Bolt branding from websites.
On paid plans, unused monthly tokens stay in the balance for up to two months.
facts.quote: Unused tokens from your monthly allowance stay in your balance for up to two months

facts.fact: Free plan tokens do not roll over to the next month.
facts.quote: Free plan tokens don’t roll over.

facts.fact: Tokens are not shared between members of a Teams plan.
Free members on a Teams plan receive no tokens and therefore cannot send prompts.
facts.quote: since free members don’t get tokens, they can’t send prompts

facts.fact: Downgrades on Bolt take effect at the next billing date, while upgrades apply right away.
facts.quote: Upgrades apply right away, and downgrades start at your next billing date.

facts.fact: After a subscription is cancelled, the plan and unused tokens stay active until the current billing period ends, then the account moves to the Free plan.
facts.quote: Your plan and unused tokens stay active until your current billing period ends, then your account moves to the Free plan.

facts.fact: Bolt describes tokens as the measure of work it does on a project, used when reading prompts and project files, making a plan, or writing code.
facts.quote: Tokens are how Bolt measures the work it does on your project.
